title: Um café antes de voltar para casa
grammar: And e but para juntar duas ideias simples
reading: Tina and her friend Lou go to a coffee shop.
Tina has a cup of coffee and a cookie.
Lou is tired, but he wants to read a book.
He wants to go home and sleep.
Tina says he can stay a little longer.
They sit at a table and talk about their walk.
dialogue: Do you want a cup of coffee, Lou?
Yes, please. A cookie too, please.
Sure. Take the table by the window. I have a text message to read.
Thank you. I want to stay, but I want to go home soon.
Can you stay a little longer? My friend is early, and she wants to meet you.
Okay, I can stay. You talk to her, and I read my book.
Good. You are tired, so please sit here with me.
Yes, I am tired. I sit here with my cup of coffee.

title: Geladeira vazia na cozinha
grammar: Some e any em frases e perguntas
reading: Mia opens the fridge, and it is almost empty.
There is some yogurt and one orange.
There isn't any butter, and there aren't any tomatoes.
Tom looks at the stove, and then at the oven.
"There are some noodles in the box," he says.
Mia says, "I cook, and you wash the dishes."
dialogue: Tom, I am hungry. What is in the fridge?
Not much. I see some yogurt and one orange.
Is there any chocolate? I want something sweet.
No chocolate, sorry. But I see an onion and a carrot.
Hmm. The market across the bridge is open now.
Okay. I can go there. What do we need?
Please buy some noodles and some butter.
Sure, no problem. I go now, and you wait here.

title: Feriado de fim de ano
reading: December is the last month of the year.
Christmas is on December twenty-fifth.
New Year's Eve is on December thirty-first.
Mia sends a holiday card with a stamp from the post office.
In winter, the town has beautiful lights.
At midnight on New Year's Eve, there are fireworks!
dialogue: Mia, what is the date today?
It is December thirteenth, and winter is here.
What day is the holiday party at school?
It is on December twentieth, at six in the evening.
Great! I need a small gift, maybe a shirt, for my uncle.
Me too. A nice scarf is thirteen dollars. Thanks for the idea!
You are welcome. And New Year's Eve is December thirty-first, right?
Yes, it is. We can watch the fireworks from my window.

title: Procurando o guarda-chuva perdido
reading: It is a rainy day, and Rosa is at the airport lost and found.
A clerk puts three things on the desk: a purse, gloves, and a watch.
Rosa sees her wallet, and it is hers.
Her passport is inside, and her umbrella is there too.
Her brother Leo is with her, and he sees his jeans and his glasses.
The jeans are his, and the glasses are his too.
dialogue: Hello! Can I help you? Do you need something?
Yes, please. I'm looking for a small brown wallet. It has a card.
I see one here. Is this your wallet? Look inside, please.
Yes, it is. This wallet is mine! Thank you so much.
You're welcome. What about this watch? Is it yours?
No, it's not mine. It's his, I think. He's with me.
Okay. And look at this red umbrella. It's wet from the rain and the wind.
Oh, yes! That's my umbrella, and now I'm ready for the rain.

title: Show de mágica no teatro infantil
grammar: Where e when em perguntas simples
reading: The kids are at the theater for a magic show.
The magician has a long cape with a gold star.
He has a wand, and he can do a trick with a hat.
He puts a rabbit in a basket, but it is not a trap.
He opens an umbrella, and the rabbit jumps out of it.
The kids laugh, and they love the surprise.
dialogue: Mom, when is the magic show? Is it now?
No, it starts at three. It is at the theater, in the big room.
Where is the magician? I can't see him yet.
He is near the curtain. Look, he is coming out now!
Wow! I love his big wand.
It is in his hand. Watch him do a trick with the rabbit.
Look, the basket is empty! Where is the rabbit?
Here it is, on his arm! What a surprise, Noah!

title: Pizza por telefone
grammar: Partitivos (a slice of, a bottle of, a piece of)
reading: It is movie night, and Ana is at home with her cousin Leo.
They have popcorn, but they are still hungry.
Ana calls the pizza place and asks for delivery.
She would like half and half. One topping is ham, and the other topping is cheese.
The delivery driver is here, and the pizza has a lot of sauce.
Leo has pizza on his pants, and the two cats are happy!
dialogue: Hello, Pizza Palace. What would you like?
Hi! I would like one large pizza for delivery, please.
Sure. Is it half and half?
Yes, it is. Ham on one side and cheese on the other side.
Nice. Can I add a bottle of water for you?
Yes, please. And can I have a slice of cake?
Sure. There is also a piece of garlic bread for movie night, and the sauce is free.
Great, that is all. Thank you very much!

title: Ônibus pela cidade
reading: Tom is a commuter, and he goes downtown by bus.
His route is long, and there is a lot of traffic.
Today the bus is crowded, and Tom is near the door.
The driver is nice, but this trip is slow.
At Main Street, Tom has a transfer to Bus 5.
Tom says, "Get off here!" He is late, and his face is red.
dialogue: Hi, Tom! Are you here for the bus?
Yes, I am. I go downtown by bus, and it is a long route.
Really? I go by taxi, and the driver is very nice.
A taxi is nice, but the traffic is bad. The bus is slow today.
Look, here is the bus. Do not miss it!
Wow, it is crowded! Can you see a seat?
Yes, there is a seat behind the driver. Sit there, and put on your seatbelt.
Thanks. Is there a transfer at Main Street?
Yes, there is. Take Bus 5, and get off here at Pine Street.
Great, that is clear. Thank you, Mia!

title: Abastecendo no posto
reading: Rosa is at the gas station with her car.
The tank is empty, and she says, "Fill it up, please."
The pump is very old, but it works.
The price is too high today.
The hose is too short, and the car is too far.
Rosa can run inside to pay, and she is very happy.
dialogue: Good afternoon! Pump number three is free.
Thanks. Fill it up, please. The tank is very empty.
Sure. Regular fuel or premium?
Regular, please. Wow, the price is too high today!
Yes, it is. Gas is expensive this week.
That is too much money! And my route is very long today.
I know. Is your tent in the car? You need a flashlight and a lot of gas for camping.
True. Please check the tires, and clean the window.
No problem. It is done, and the tank is full now.
Perfect, it is full. Thank you!

title: Domingo na pista de skate
reading: Every Sunday, Ben and Mia go to the skate park.
Ben has a skateboard, and he always has his knee pads.
The ramp is big, and the sky is blue.
Ben can ride fast, but the ramp is a little scary.
"Do not skip the knee pads!" says Mia.
After the park, they have pizza.
dialogue: Hey, Ben! Are you ready for the ramp today?
Yes, I am. I come here every Sunday morning.
Me too! I skate here every morning with my dad.
Every morning? Wow, I am tired every day!
Look, I can jump now! Watch me.
Nice jump! Be safe, and put on your knee pads.
Ouch! I fall on the ramp, and my tooth hurts a little, but I am okay.
Good. The ramp is scary, but it is fun.
Yes! After skating, can we order a pizza for delivery?
Sure, that is a great idea!

title: Colegas de trabalho novos
grammar: Be + adjetivo de personalidade com very e really
reading: Rosa has a new colleague, and his name is Noah.
Noah is very funny, and he has a big smile.
Lia is shy, but she is really smart and kind.
At the meeting, they are all polite.
Rosa and Noah are in the same soccer league on Saturday.
They get along well, and Rosa is happy.
dialogue: Hi, Rosa! How is your new job?
It is great! My new colleagues are really nice.
Really? Tell me about them. Who is Noah?
Noah is very funny. He is big and strong, and he plays in a soccer league.
And the woman near the window? Is she nice too?
That is Lia. She is shy, but she is really smart.
Great! So you get along well with them, right?
Yes, we do. We eat together in the kitchen at lunch.
That is nice. Is your route to work easy now?
Yes, it is. I have one transfer, and I am a happy commuter.

title: Jogo de futebol
grammar: Play e go + esporte (play soccer, go running)
reading: Lia and Noah play soccer on Saturday.
Noah is on a team with his colleague Tom.
The field is big, and the day is hot.
Noah can kick the ball very hard.
He can score a goal, and the team can win.
After the game, they stop at the gas station for water.
dialogue: Hi, Noah! Can you play soccer with us today?
Yes, I can! I play soccer on Saturday and tennis on Sunday.
Great. The game is at the field near the school, and it is hot today.
No problem. I go to the field by skateboard, and I have water.
Funny! My colleague Tom goes running before the game, so he is ready.
Cool. Can I kick the ball first, please?
Sure. Kick it hard, and try to score a goal.
Look, I score a goal! Is it good?
Yes, great goal! Now our team can win today.
Yes, we can win! Who has the water?

title: Escolhendo tênis
reading: Ana and her colleague Ben are at a shoe store, and there is snow outside.
Ana wants a pair of sneakers for tennis.
The blue sneakers are the cheapest.
The black sneakers are the best, and they are light.
The laces are white, and the price is fifty dollars.
They are expensive, but Ana likes them.
dialogue: Do you like these sneakers for tennis, Ana?
Yes, I do. They are the best in the store.
Really? The sandals are cheap here, and they look cool.
I know, but I need shoes for soccer with my team.
Okay. Are the boots good for soccer?
No, they aren't. They are the heaviest in the store.
Then try the black sneakers. They are the lightest.
Oh, they are very comfortable, and the laces are white!
Great! Is the price fifty dollars?
Yes, it is. Let's pay and then eat a snack.

title: Inverno na cabana
grammar: In + estação e it gets + adjetivo
reading: Rosa and Noah are in a cabin in winter.
It gets very cold, and there is snow outside.
Noah puts wood on the fire.
The fireplace is big, and the room gets warm fast.
Rosa has a scarf, gloves and a pair of boots.
Her feet are cold, and she wants to warm up.
dialogue: It is cold in winter here. Come to the fireplace, Rosa!
Thanks! My feet are wet from the snow.
Take off your boots, and put them near the fire.
Good idea. I have a sweater in my bag, and a scarf too.
In the morning, it gets very cold in this cabin.
Really? Then I need my gloves, and I need to warm up!
I have hot cocoa for you. It is on the table.
Wonderful! Does your puppy like the cabin in winter?
Yes, he does. He sleeps next to the fireplace all day.
Great! Now everyone is warm, and the cabin is nice.

title: Aula de dança
reading: Lia is a dancer on a dance team.
Today she has a lesson on the stage.
Her teacher says, "Move slowly and feel the rhythm."
Lia can jump high, and she spins fast.
Max wears sneakers, and he dances fast.
They warm up first, and then they dance together.
dialogue: Max, your feet are fast, but the music is slow.
Oh, sorry! I want to be a good dancer on the stage.
Then listen to this rhythm. Dance slowly, and move your feet.
Like this? I can jump, but I cannot spin well.
No problem. Look at that teacher, and step to the beat.
She is a great dancer. She always steps to the beat.
Yes, she is. Do you warm up before the lesson?
Yes, I do. I run and move my arms first.
Good! Now try again, and listen to the beat.
Look, I spin well now. I can do it!

title: Passeio com a câmera
grammar: How about + verbo com -ing para sugerir
reading: Kim and Dan are at the zoo on a sunny day.
Kim has a camera, and Dan has a tripod.
Kim wears sneakers, and Dan wears boots.
They want a selfie with the tigers.
Dan says, "How about taking a photo here?"
Kim smiles, and Dan presses the button.
dialogue: Kim, how about taking a selfie by the tigers?
Good idea! Where is my camera, Dan?
It is in your bag, and I have a tripod too.
Great. How about putting the camera on the tripod?
Okay. Strike a pose, and say cheese, please!
Cheese! Is my smile good, or is it too small?
It is very good. Your scarf looks great in the photo.
Thanks! Now let's take a tour of the zoo.
Sure. How about walking to the monkeys first?
Yes, that is a great plan!

title: Videochamada com a equipe
grammar: Present continuous negativo e perguntas (I'm not, Are you?)
reading: Noah is at home, and he has a meeting at nine.
He sits at his laptop and puts on a headset.
His webcam is on, but the signal is weak.
Mia is in a cabin with her puppy.
The puppy wants pet food, and he is loud.
Noah says, "Mia, you're on mute!"
dialogue: Hi, Mia! Can you join the meeting now?
Yes, I can. I have my laptop and my headset here.
Great. Are you using your webcam today?
No, I'm not using it. The signal is weak in my cabin.
Hmm, I cannot hear you. Is your microphone working?
Yes, it is. Can you hear me now?
No, I can't. Wait, you're on mute!
Oh, sorry! Is this loud? My puppy is big, and he is very noisy.
Ha! Tell him to sit, and let's start.
Okay, he sits now, and I am ready for the meeting.

title: Revisão: Dia de mudança
grammar: Revisão: have to, can, there is/are e preposições de lugar
reading: Tom and Ana have a big moving day.
The truck is in front of the apartment, near a tree.
They have to carry the furniture upstairs.
There are many boxes, and the tape is on the table.
The sofa is next to the door, and the lamp is behind it.
Ana has her camera, and she wants a photo of the new kitchen.
dialogue: The truck is here, Ana. We have to carry the furniture upstairs.
Okay. Where does the sofa go?
There is a place between the window and the lamp. The wall has new paint.
Good. The bed is very heavy. Can you help me, please?
Sure. Let's try! You have to hold it on the left.
Okay. Where is the tape? I have to close this box.
It is on the kitchen table, next to the brush.
Here it is! There are two mirrors in this box. Can you take them?
Yes, I can. I put them behind the sofa for now.
Perfect! Everything is in the right place now.

title: Consertando o carro na oficina
reading: Ben has a brown truck.
The truck is old, but it is big enough for his boxes.
Today the engine is very loud.
Ben takes the truck to a mechanic.
The mechanic opens the hood and looks at the engine.
The brake is not good enough, so he repairs it.
dialogue: Hi, Mr. Cruz. My brown truck is very loud today.
Really? Please open the hood. I want to see the engine.
Sure. Here you are. Is the engine bad?
No, the engine is fine. But the brake is not good enough.
Oh no. Can you repair it today? I have an order for a customer.
Yes, I can. I have the tool, and the truck is not too damaged.
Great. Please change the oil, too. Is five o'clock late enough for you?
Yes, it is. Please bring the truck back at five.

title: Trilha na montanha
grammar: How far + distância (How far is it?)
reading: Mia and Ben are on a mountain trail.
The air is cool, and a bird sings near the river.
There is a written sign by the rock: two miles.
Mia asks, "How far is the hill?"
It is only one mile, so they climb up.
At the top, they eat a sausage and see a big field.
dialogue: Ben, look at the mountain! Is that the top?
Yes, it is. How far is it from here?
I press the button on my phone. It says three miles.
Three miles? Is that far?
No, it is not far. Our truck is by the river, and the air is cool.
Okay. I have a sausage and some water. How far is the hill?
The hill is near, only one mile. Then we climb up the rock.
Great. Well done, Mia. Let's go!
